coverage: All Git history reachable from bundled refs; selected baseline documents and current documentation from registered worktrees. Current selection: docs/** including ignored receipts, root Markdown, .claude/skills/** and .agents/skills/**. Python bytecode/cache excluded. Symlinks retained, not followed. Capture is per-file, not a global atomic snapshot. External evidence, local configuration outside selected paths, reflog-only or unreachable objects, filesystem ownership/ACL/xattrs and remote-only refs are not captured. Signatures retained as bytes; authenticity not verified. No authority or qualification change.
